title: Exploring Widower's Nest
description: Exploring Widower's Nest — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Explore

Quest Description: Explore many locations connected to Widower's Nest and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston. Involves visiting the locations: Ruins of Castle Caninenstein, Maerz Catacombs of Doom, Doug's Digsite, Tomb of the Ice Climber, and Xhelduh's Hideout.

Quest Reward: 5000 Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile in Townston

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Explore the many locations connected to Widower's Nest and Return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Ok, you've heard the big news then, right? We got a used copy of the Widower's Nest! Do you have any idea how many a fortnight I spent running that dungeon back when I was in college? Me and my frag brothers would grab a case of health potions and run that dungeon until we died, over and over again!

Ok, well, you can tell I am pretty excited, but there is more. The Widower's Nest was part of a collection of used dungeons, so I need you to go into the Widower's Nest and explore all of the connections off the main dungeon. Come back to me, Loremaster Vraile, here in Townston when you have the entire dungeon mapped out.

Turn-in:

Success again? Wow, I don't even recognize some of these dungeons...

Objectives:

  • Explore Ruins of Castle Caninenstein
  • Explore Maerz Catacombs of Doom
  • Return to the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein
  • Explore Doug's Digsite
  • Explore Tomb of the Ice Climber
  • Explore Xhelduh's Hideout

Client level range: 20–40
